offering_description.value: Climb Global Solutions is a value-added IT distributor and solutions provider. It distributes specialty software, security, data management and infrastructure products from vendors to resellers, MSPs and system integrators, and offers related channel services.

primary_products.value: specialty software licenses; cybersecurity software; data management and storage software; infrastructure software; IT hardware

primary_services.value: value-added distribution services; software license management; vendor-managed channel programs; technical support and enablement; marketing and lead-generation services

customer_segment.value: B2B: value-added resellers, MSPs, system integrators, consultants and corporate resellers

end_markets.value: information technology; cybersecurity; enterprise software; data management; managed services

revenue_model.value: product sales: resale of software and hardware licenses purchased from vendors; service fees: channel services, renewals, support and enablement; subscription: resale of subscription software and renewals

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys software and hardware from technology vendors and sells to resellers and MSPs; service provider: provides channel, marketing and technical services to vendors and partners

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe (UK, Germany and others) and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: software distribution, hardware distribution and channel services for IT vendors

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to resellers, MSPs and integrators; online: partner portals and e-commerce ordering platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general business, trade, export and data privacy rules

notes: Details are from general knowledge; segment names and geographies may have changed.
